fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Master switch. Untick to stop queueing and sending at once.

fields.label: Test Mode
fields.description: Send to the Test Events tab only. Rows stay Approved and go for real once this is unticked.

fields.label: Test Event Code
fields.description: From Events Manager > Test Events (looks like TEST12345).

fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: Only orders created on or after this date are queued (never older than 7 days).

fields.label: Approval Mode
fields.description: Every order: each order waits for a manager. Held only: only orders above the hold amount wait.

fields.label: Hold Orders Above (EGP)
fields.description: Orders above this value are Held for a manager whatever the approval mode.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: Conversions API token from Events Manager > Settings. Stored encrypted; only a System Manager can see or change it.

fields.label: Excluded Customer Groups
fields.default:
B2B
Employee
Commercial
Distributor
Government
Non Profit
Sample
fields.description: One per line. Orders from these groups are never queued. A single customer can also be excluded with Exclude from Meta on the Customer.
